issues.claim_quote: Across the whole packet, participant experience follows one dominant pattern shown by the cited source.
issues.mechanism: The evidence presents isolated anecdotes and personal reflections, lacking a broader, systematic analysis of participant experience.
issues.material_consequence: The claim falsely suggests a unified pattern without sufficient evidence to support it.

review.rationale: The provided excerpts offer fragmented personal accounts, not a systematic assessment of a dominant pattern across the entire participant group. The claim makes an unwarranted generalization.
